I give talks that make AI **un-foolable** for the people who have to make decisions
about it: executives, boards, CIOs, and the IT leaders who carry the budget. No vendor
theater, no jargon. Just the gears, exposed, with demos the room runs themselves.

The view comes from the intersection most speakers only stand at one corner of: I
**build** real software, **govern** it (I authored my organization's enterprise AI
governance framework), and **teach** it to thousands of students a year. See [more
about that](/about.qmd).

## Topics I speak on

- **Demystifying AI.** From the simplest machine-learning model to the architectural
  frontier, in plain language, with [run-it-yourself demos](/labs/index.qmd).
- **Enterprise AI governance.** Building a framework that lets an organization move
  fast without betting the company.
- **AI-assisted development.** What it actually changes for how software gets built.
- **Quantum readiness.** What leaders should be doing now, separated from the hype.

Formats range from a 60–75 minute keynote with live demos to half-day executive
workshops. Talks can be tailored to a board, an IT org, or a general business audience.
